highlights.name: Spiral arm
highlights.description: Look across the tilted disk as the cluster comes into view.

highlights.name: Cluster pass
highlights.description: Compare the nearby warm stars with the distant spiral.

highlights.name: Galaxy panorama
highlights.description: Look back across the spiral from the halo.

highlights.name: Blue cloud approach
highlights.description: See the blue glow against the distant stellar field.

highlights.name: Among the filaments
highlights.description: Look around the layered blue emission region.

highlights.name: Violet cloud reveal
highlights.description: Look toward the violet cloud after the curved passage.

highlights.name: Spiral skim
highlights.description: Look across the tilted arms of the nearby spiral.

highlights.name: Golden elliptical pass
highlights.description: Compare the smooth warm halo with the nearby spiral.

highlights.name: Galaxy group panorama
highlights.description: Look back across the spiral and elliptical together.

highlights.name: Amber photosphere
highlights.description: Pause beside the warm star to inspect its illustrative surface.

highlights.name: Blue star pass
highlights.description: Compare the blue-white surface and the moving stellar background.

highlights.name: Pale star reveal
highlights.description: Look across the pale star with the blue emission region beyond.

highlights.name: Above the spiral arms
highlights.description: Look toward the inner arm from above the generated disk.

highlights.name: Inside the stellar disk
highlights.description: Pause among the existing three-dimensional stars and emission records as the camera crosses the disk.

highlights.name: Beyond the disk
highlights.description: Look back at the spiral after emerging on the other side of the tilted disk.
